topics.purpose: Define membership as explicit evidence linking an IAM identity or group to an exact group with lifecycle and provenance.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant membership has an explicit membership identity/evidence record.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Effective start/end are explicit where temporal membership applies.
semantics.rights_rule: Membership gains only rights explicitly assigned through applicable policy/role bindings.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
